headline: Decent Q2; Strong Order Inflow but Cautious on Margins

highlights: Change in Estimates Current Previous CY27E CY28E CY27E CY28E Rating Hold Hold Target Price 7,016 6,944 Sales (INR mn) 173,501 207,661 172,567 205,489 % Chng. 0.5 1.1 EBITDA (INR mn) 26,736 33,278 27,956 33,906 % Chng.

ABB India (ABB) reported a decent quarterly performance with revenue growing ~19% YoY to Rs37.4bn, while EBITDA margin contracted 75bps YoY to 13.7% due to elevated raw material costs and currency volatility.

ABB reported strong order inflows of INR47bn (+56% YoY), with broad-based growth across business segments and end- markets, led by Electrification (+117% YoY) and supported by large data-centre orders.
The order backlog remains healthy, with data centres accounting for 15–20%.

The stock currently trades at P/E of 67.6x/54.2x on CY27E/28E.

We maintain our ‘Hold’ rating, valuing the stock at a P/E of 58x Sep’28E (58x Jun’28E earlier), as visibility of growth momentum remains intact across diverse end user segments, resulting in revised TP of INR7,016 (INR6,944 earlier).
